summary: Assess PPP affordability, guarantees and contingent liabilities using PFRAM-based case work. Explore the course and strengthen fiscal-risk reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for officials and infrastructure professionals who review, monitor or report the fiscal consequences of PPP commitments. It suits cross-functional teams that need to connect project evidence with budget decisions, audit work and public-sector disclosure.
prerequisites: Prior familiarity with public budgeting, public investment appraisal or PPP project review is recommended. No coding or programming is required. You should be comfortable reviewing project costs, payment schedules and basic financial information in a spreadsheet.
